Welterweight fighter Daniel Rodriguez headlines Rogan's MMA Show number 180. Rodriguez built his record the hard way, through grit and volume. His style favors pressure and tough exchanges.

Rogan reviews his fights and what makes his game work. They talk about camps, cuts, and the grind below the spotlight. Rodriguez shares his path from hard years to the big stage. The episode suits fans who love working fighters more than stars: men who earn each shot and talk about the cost without complaint. Respect runs under every exchange in the room.
